words.example: Please show families to the waiting area on the left of the lobby.
words.exampleZh: 请把家属带到大厅左侧的等候区。

words.example: Each visitor has to sign the reception log before going upstairs.
words.exampleZh: 每位访客上楼之前，都必须在接待登记上签名。

words.example: After six, the night guard is the one who keeps the visitor log.
words.exampleZh: 六点以后，访客登记由夜班警卫保管。

words.example: Badge return happens at the security desk by the main door.
words.exampleZh: 工牌归还在正门旁边的安保台办理。

words.example: Sign the key register before you take the storeroom key away.
words.exampleZh: 把库房钥匙拿走之前，请先在钥匙登记上签名。

words.example: The cumulative update for May rebooted three clinic PCs that were left on.
words.exampleZh: 五月的累积更新把三台没关机的门诊电脑重启了。

words.example: The security bulletin describes a spooler flaw that hits every ward print server.
words.exampleZh: 这份安全公告写的是一个影响每台病区打印服务器的打印后台漏洞。

words.example: Quote the KB number when you ask the vendor why this patch broke printing.
words.exampleZh: 问厂商这个补丁为什么把打印弄坏时，把知识库编号一起报上。

words.example: Reboot pending has been set on the pharmacy PC since Tuesday's patch.
words.exampleZh: 从周二的补丁起，药房电脑就一直是等待重启。

words.example: A pending reboot is blocking further patches on the registration PCs.
words.exampleZh: 待重启状态挡住了挂号电脑上后面的补丁。
